description: This file contains a utility class 'CacheUtils' designed to interact with a cache system, providing methods to put, retrieve, and delete cached data, as well as retrieve cache keys associated with a MerchantStore.

classes.name: CacheUtils
classes.description: A utility class for managing cache operations such as put, get, remove, and retrieving keys related to MerchantStore.

methods.name: putInCache
methods.description: Puts an object into the cache with a specified key.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the cache by its key.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of cache keys associated with a given MerchantStore.

methods.name: shutDownCache
methods.description: Intended to shut down the cache, but currently has no implementation.

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes an object from the cache by its key.

methods.name: removeAllFromCache
methods.description: Removes all cache entries associated with a specific MerchantStore.
